request.label: r3-refresh3-matrix-endpoints-forecast
command:
from pathlib import Path
import json,sys
from resources import atomic,identity
from task2r_run import balance
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
book=root/"accounting.json"
names=("r3-signed-refresh3-middle","r3-retained-refresh3-coarse","r3-retained-refresh3-middle")
cases=[root/"evidence"/(name+".json") for name in names]
assert all(json.loads(path.read_text())["final_time"]==.08 for path in cases)
comparisons=[root/"evidence"/f"r3-{role}-refresh3-common-t{stamp}.json" for role in ("signed","retained") for stamp in ("004","008")]
assert all(json.loads(path.read_text())["status"]=="MET" for path in comparisons)
atomic(Path(sys.argv[2]),dict(schema="WJH27R3MatrixEndpointForecastV1",audit_refs=[identity(root/"operations"/name/"receipt.json")
     for name in ("r3-audit-signed-refresh3-uninterrupted","r3-audit-signed-refresh3-resumed")],
     cases=[identity(path) for path in cases], comparisons=[identity(path) for path in comparisons],
     cpu_threads=1, native_gauss_orders=[6,8], independent_orders=[20,24], audit_cap=1450,
     rss_gib=10, address_gib=8, account=balance(json.loads(book.read_text())),ledger=identity(book),
     purpose="Complete matched t=.08 independent equation and physical audits for the selected-recipe candidates."))
